01-apply-form.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): public application form. Checks the answers and the PDF CV, starts screening in the background and shows a thank-you page.

02-screen-application.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): reads the CV (GPT-5.4 mini), anonymises it, scores it against the job criteria (GPT-5.4), bands it in code, saves it and sends emails.

03-send-email.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): sends an email with Gmail in live mode, or writes it to the Northgate Outbox table in test mode.

04-recruiter-dashboard.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): the recruiter dashboard page, its action endpoint (invite, reject, hold) and CV downloads. Protected by a key.

05-candidate-action.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): carries out a recruiter decision. Invite offers interview slots by email, reject sends a polite note, hold parks the candidate.

06-book-interview.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): the candidate picks an interview slot from their email link; the slot is re-checked and booked in the calendar.

07-weekly-report.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): Monday 8 am pipeline report for the recruiter: applications, bands, decisions waiting and interviews.

08-reset-demo.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): clears candidates, emails, files and events and puts example busy times in the test calendar.

09-calendar.ts.description: CV screening (project 10): calendar adapter. Lists busy times and books interviews in Google Calendar (live) or the Northgate Calendar table (test).
